judgements.justification: A's oT7u 'had to read into related work' to follow the method and wanted rejection over the rewrite, while B's computational-anatomy expert xE8n called the paper well written.
oT7u stated its raise to 5 and kept arguing rejection consistently; iY4e's silent edit has no known score change, and no B score moved.
Neither AC set aside a low rating for silence; A's four below-threshold ratings all counted and B had no detractor below threshold.
No reviewer in either committee rated above 7 or argued for the paper on a checked reading; B's best-informed reviewer xE8n warned against overstating it.
No reviewer admitted reading only part of the paper; B's least careful reviewer 4s5o rated at confidence 2, not high confidence.
xE8n read from computational anatomy but disputed only the novelty claim, not the premise, and called the work an 'excellent application'.
B's AC gave a spotlight over 7, 7, 7, 6 that no reviewer asked for and stated no reason for the higher tier, calling prior work 'the only controversy'.
B's xE8n knew the mesh LDDMM literature, but A's reviewers did not take the comparisons at face value: they asked for VoxelMorph, EMD and outlier-robust HD.
B's AC omitted EX4h's small-gain point, but in the direction of a higher tier; A's AC named no flaw but did not misstate its reviewers' negative positions.
Only B's xE8n doubted the NeurIPS fit, and B still gave a spotlight; A raised no breadth concern.
B had no low-scoring detractor; A's reviewers' misreadings sat among uniformly low scores and its AC rejected, not argued acceptance.
B saw a new max-HD table, but it drew no reply and moved no score; A's only score change followed clarifications, not new results.
B's expert xE8n rated 7, no higher than the other B reviewers, and A had no high-confidence expert rating above the rest.
No reviewer added a new objection after the response period; ZUMJ's edit predates the rebuttal and oT7u's raise came during discussion.
The rating gap follows opposite verbal judgements: A called the exposition fatal and a major revision, while B called the results impressive and the faults camera-ready fixes.
B's xE8n judged the novelty overstated and the authors promised a refocus, but B still gave a spotlight, so the claim capped no tier.
A rated 4, 3, 5, 5 below threshold, and B's reviewers rated 7, 7, 7, 6 mostly at confidence 4; no committee converged on flat marginal-accept 6s.
